verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a full public API for programmatic control (projects, experiments, datasets, prompts, tools, scorers, logs) plus SDKs in multiple languages, a CLI, and an MCP server for agent-driven interaction, giving AI-native users multiple documented ways to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs.md (probes returned 404), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of API robustness beyond docs.
